subject: Mobile Development
title: The Gig Economy Goes Mobile
description: A 60-second lesson on The Gig Economy Goes Mobile.

hook.text: Uber, DoorDash, and Instacart created millions of jobs that exist only because of smartphones.

buildup.text: GPS, real-time communication, and mobile payments made on-demand services possible.

discovery.text: The gig economy is worth over $400 billion globally, almost entirely powered by mobile apps.

twist.text: Gig workers lack benefits and stability. Courts worldwide are debating their employment status.

climax.text: Mobile apps created a new kind of work — flexible but precarious.

punchline.text: Smartphones created jobs — and a labor debate.

quiz.question: What mobile technology enabled the gig economy?
options: GPS, real-time communication, and mobile payments
